mapper.sql: st.spot_idx, st.spot_id, st.name, st.region, st.address, st.latitude, st.longitude, st.description, /* SPOT_REVIEW 실시간 평균 평점 */ COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND(AVG(sr.rating), 1) FROM SPOT_REVIEW sr WHERE sr.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ), 0.0) AS rating_avg_real, /* SPOT_REVIEW 실시간 리뷰 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_REVIEW sr WHERE sr.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ) AS review_count_real, /* SPOT_LIKE 실시간 좋아요 수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SPOT_LIKE sl WHERE sl.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ) AS like_count_real, /* 대표 이미지 */ ( SELECT si.image_url FROM SPOT_IMAGE si WHERE si.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ORDER BY si.image_idx ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumb_url, /* 태그 (콤마 구분) */ ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tl.tag_name ORDER BY tl.tag_name SEPARATOR ',') FROM SPOT_TAG s_tag JOIN SPOT_TAG_LIST tl ON tl.tag_idx = s_tag.tag_idx WHERE s_tag.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ) AS tags_concat
